textRuns.value: Volume tier (rolling 12 weeks), ranked within your own population: Power = top 10% by prompt volume and active in 9 of 12 weeks; Habitual = top 40% and active in 9 of 12; Novice = top 80%; Low = below that; Inactive = no prompts. Tiers need at least 20 active users to compute.

Delegation ladder: Automating = any lifetime scheduled-task total; Delegating = 30%+ multi-skill tasks; Using = average task duration 5+ minutes; Trying = shorter single-skill tasks; Not started = no observed tasks. The 5-minute and 30% cuts are template conventions to revisit with tenant evidence.
